title: China fact of the day - Marginal REVOLUTION
gist: Advanced AI video-generation tools, led by ByteDance's Seedance 2.0, are displacing human actors and influencers across China's short-drama gig economy, with AI now dominating the top animated dramas on Douyin.

insights.claim: Cost-effective advanced AI video generation software is threatening millions of jobs in China's short-drama and online-influencer gig economy by letting digital actors replace humans.
insights.speaker: Tyler Cowen
insights.so_what: Signals that generative video is already at commercial labor-substitution scale in one large market, a leading indicator for creative-labor disruption elsewhere.
insights.quote: cost-effective advanced AI video generation programmes that are threatening millions of jobs in a once-vibrant area of China’s gig economy
insights.locator: Chinese actors and online influencers have a new rival

insights.claim: ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 model lets producers generate higher-quality original videos more quickly, replacing the need to shoot with human actors.
insights.speaker: Tyler Cowen
insights.so_what: Names the specific model driving displacement; ByteDance's tooling is the competitive benchmark to watch in generative video.
insights.quote: such as tech group ByteDance’s Seedance 2.0 model, has allowed digital actors to replace humans
insights.locator: The release of powerful new AI-powered video software

insights.claim: A Beijing short-drama actor-producer went from shooting three productions a week before Seedance 2.0's release to work drying up entirely after it, forcing many peers out of the industry.
insights.speaker: Tyler Cowen
insights.so_what: Ground-level evidence that the transition is measured in weeks, not years, once a capable model ships.
insights.quote: And after that, everything just went.
insights.locator: The digital takeover intensified after this year’s release

insights.claim: In May, 89 of the top 100 animated dramas on ByteDance's Douyin were AI productions, according to marketing analytics firm DataEye.
insights.speaker: Tyler Cowen
insights.so_what: A concrete 89% penetration figure quantifies how fast AI content can capture a platform's top-performing catalog.
insights.quote: 89 of the top 100 animated dramas on Douyin, ByteDance’s domestic Chinese version of TikTok, were AI productions
insights.locator: In May, 89 of the top 100 animated dramas
